description: A single-panel particle-size-distribution plot titled "Powder size distribution" for the PREP-prepared 30Mn-9Al-–C-3Ni powder. The x-axis is logarithmic and labelled "Particle sizes (mm)" — the printed unit reads mm, whereas the caption and citing text give sizes in µm — spanning 0.1 to 1000 with major gridlines at 0.1, 1, 10, 100 and 1000. The left y-axis is "Volume (%)" (0–13, tick every 1); the right y-axis is "Cumulative Volume (%)" (0–100, tick every 10). Two overlaid bar histograms — a pale blue/cyan set and a darker navy set — occupy the region between roughly 10 and 100 on the x-axis and peak near the 11–12 % gridlines; essentially no bars exist below ~10 or above ~100. A red sigmoid curve (cumulative volume) rises steeply across that same size interval and plateaus at 100 %. No numeric D50 or other value is printed on the plot itself; the caption/citing text state D50 = 35.69 µm and a main distribution of 15–53 µm. The figure demonstrates the unimodal, narrow size distribution of the powder, consistent with its reported good flowability (Hall value 14 s/50 g).

subfigures.description: One combined plot: log-scale x-axis 'Particle sizes (mm)' 0.1–1000; left y-axis 'Volume (%)' 0–13 with two overlaid bar histograms (pale cyan and dark navy) spanning ~10–100 and peaking near 11–12 %; right y-axis 'Cumulative Volume (%)' 0–100 with a red sigmoid cumulative curve that plateaus at 100 %. No legend and no printed D50 value.

observations.observation: The figure is a single plot titled "Powder size distribution" with a frequency histogram (left axis) and a cumulative curve (right axis).
The horizontal axis is logarithmic and labelled "Particle sizes (mm)", with major tick labels 0.1, 1, 10, 100 and 1000.
The left vertical axis is labelled "Volume (%)" and runs from 0 to 13 in steps of 1; the right vertical axis is labelled "Cumulative Volume (%)" and runs from 0 to 100 in steps of 10.
Two overlaid bar histograms (a pale blue/cyan set and a darker navy set) span roughly 10 to 100 on the particle-size axis and reach their maximum near the 11–12 % gridlines.
A red sigmoid curve rises steeply through the same size interval as the histogram and flattens at 100 % cumulative volume.
No histogram bars are visible below about 10 or above about 100 on the x-axis, indicating a single narrow mode with no detectable fine or coarse tail (as drawn).
No numeric value (e.g. D10, D50, D90) is printed anywhere on the plot; the only numbers are axis tick labels.
No legend is printed, so the identity of the two differently shaded bar sets (pale cyan versus dark navy) is not stated in the image.
The x-axis unit is printed as "mm" although the powder sizes discussed in the text are in the micrometre range; the image and the text unit disagree.
The caption states the figure is the particle-size distribution of the PREP-prepared 30Mn-9Al-–C-3Ni powder.
The citing text states that particles are mainly distributed in the 15–53 μm range in this figure.
The citing text states the median particle size (D50) was determined to be 35.69 μm; this value is not printed on the figure itself.
The citing text states the powder showed excellent flowability with a Hall value of 14 s/50 g, which is not shown in this figure.
The citing text states the powder was prepared by the plasma rotating electrode process (PREP) and is intended for SLM.
